observations.evidence: Source has ABC with three printed 60 angles, DEF with ticks but no printed angles, GHI without tick marks. Output incorrectly generalizes that every image has numbers and side marks and omits the actual labels/values.
Source DOES contain vertex labels A–I and captions left right-angle, middle obtuse, right acute. Output omits labels/captions and claims all diagrams have numbers; printed angle numbers are absent.
Graph subtype and axis existence are correct, but axis meanings and all six day/value pairs are missing.
Pie subtype and presence of weekday percentages are correct, but six day/percentage pairs are missing.

limitations: Classifier predicts diagrams for both geometry groups and the pie chart; this is raw classifier output, not a validated semantic label.
Model-reported uncertainties were empty despite errors/omissions. They must not be interpreted as independent confidence.
A full-page image misclassification retains a separate routing-only OCR exception for dense prose recovery. Zero such requests occurred in the completed five-page test.
Formulas outside visuals retain earlier review limitations; the two A/G fallback formula chunks are specifically removed.
Existing saved material is not silently re-extracted. The new test material is saved separately.

observations: The first triangle group now reports the A–I point labels and limits the three printed 60 values to the left panel. Its descriptions of tick marks as perpendicular lines are inaccurate.
The second triangle group reports the correct point groups, left-to-right captions and right-angle mark at B. Nonparallel-side descriptions are unhelpful inferred detail.
All six line-chart day/value pairs are correct. The vertical axis meaning is misplaced as a title and its wording is not the exact printed label.
All six pie-chart day/percentage pairs are correct. Several sector locations are wrong and descriptions of lines are generic.
Model uncertainty is still empty despite these errors.
